AssetHoard v0.1.0b Release Notes

A wild asset manager appears!

After 193 commits of caffeine-fuelled development, we're thrilled to unleash AssetHoard into the wild. What started as "I just want to organise my game assets" has evolved into a full-fledged desktop application built with Rust.

✨ Key Features

🗂️ Bundle System Nested bundles, drag-and-drop organisation, smart folder import, and customisable cover images. It's bundleception.

🎨 Extensive Format Support

  • 3D Models (GLB, GLTF, OBJ, FBX, ABC) — Full preview with animation playback
  • Images & Textures (PNG, JPG, PSD, KRA, SVG, TGA)
  • Sprites (Aseprite) — Frame-by-frame preview with timing
  • Audio (MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, MIDI) — Waveform visualisation and piano roll
  • Game Packages — Unity .unitypackage and Godot .zip support with licence detection

🔍 Search & Organisation Full-text search, faceted filtering by type/category/tags, and a comprehensive category system.

⚡ Quality of Life

  • 15+ keyboard shortcuts (press ? to see them all)
  • Background imports with progress notifications
  • Watched folders with live updates
  • Duplicate detection
  • Resizable panels, grid/list views, virtualised scrolling
  • Auto-updater (Windows, macOS), and and cross-platform support (windows, mac, and linux)

🔧 Under the Hood

SQLite database with idempotent migrations, full backup/restore with automatic schema versioning, and a comprehensive test suite.

✉️ Join the beta program

If you're interested in joining the beta group sign up here. Let us know what you do, and why you'd love to give AssetHoard a go.

🚀 What's Next?

This is v0.1 — the dragon is still young. Future plans include more format support, enhanced tagging workflows, batch operation improvements, and whatever cool features you suggest!

May your assets be organised and your bundles be nested.

Happy hoarding! 🐉
Linux builds are here! Debian and RPM packages ready to go, with AUR support on the way.

AssetHoard v0.1.1 Release Notes

Linux has landed!

We've been hard at work bringing AssetHoard to our Linux friends. This release includes ready-to-use Debian (.deb) and RPM packages. AUR support is still in progress — stay tuned!

🐧 Linux Support

Full Linux builds are now available:

  • Debian (.deb) — Ready for Ubuntu, Debian, and derivatives
  • RPM — Ready for Fedora, RHEL, and derivatives
  • AUR — Coming soon!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • File path resolution — Resolved file paths incorrectly resolving on Linux
  • Audio playback — Fixed audio playback issues
  • File system permissions — Streamlined permissions with scoped access
  • Bundle search context — Fixed search context not resetting when navigating away from a bundle

✨ Improvements

  • Watched folders — Updated subfolder checkbox label to be more user-friendly

May your assets be organised and your bundles be nested.

Happy hoarding! 🐉
